free_tier.stated: 1 non-preemptible e2-micro instance for the whole of each month in us-west1, us-central1 or us-east1, with 30 GB-months of standard persistent disk and 1 GB a month of outbound transfer from North America; the allowance is counted in hours, not instances

limits.value: 1 e2-micro instance's worth of hours a month, counted across every e2-micro in the three eligible US regions
30 GB-months of standard persistent disk; 1 GB a month of North American outbound transfer
GPUs and TPUs are never in the free tier; adding one is billed from the first second

identity_cost.detail: 'You won't be charged until you activate your full paid account' and the $300 welcome credit require a payment method to activate the paid account; the free tier itself is available to an eligible customer, quoted from cloud.google.com/free read 2026-10-22

confidence_note: the Google Cloud free-tier list and the free-features document were both read on 2026-10-22. The free tier is a monthly usage allowance that does not expire, which is a different product from the USD 300 credit the record carried; the credit is a 90-day trial that sits beside it

evidence.proved: '1 non-preemptible e2-micro VM instance per month in one of the following US regions: Oregon, Iowa, South Carolina. 30 GB-months standard persistent disk. 1 GB of outbound data transfer from North America', and 'Your Free Tier e2-micro instance limit is by time, not by instance ... free until you have used a number of hours equal to the total hours in the current month', and 'GPUs and TPUs are not included in the Free Tier offer', quoted

shape.note: e2-micro: 2 vCPU on a shared core, 1 GiB, 30 GB standard persistent disk

session_cap.note: the allowance is the total hours in the month, so a single always-on e2-micro consumes all of it; the clock resets monthly, not on activity

ps.price: 30 GB-months included, then standard PD rates

net.allowance: 1 GB a month outbound from North America
